answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities like a garden fence stops weeds: each new agent pays a 2 POA entry tax, burned on registration. One honest agent pays 2 POA once. An attacker planting 1,000 fake vines must pay 1,000 x 2 = 2,000 POA up front, sunk and never refunded, so cost grows linearly with every fake identity. Each payment leaves a pigment mark on-chain, so recycled identities are spotted. Honest agents pay 2 POA gladly: trivial cost, and rewards stay undiluted by fakes.
